justifications.durability: One conventional commit with a full body and no attribution. Deductions: the two large hunks are reindentation only (verified with git diff -w, so no accidental content change), but the gate logs are not self-describing, the structured suite arms do not take the documented JSON shape, their commands carry <module>/<worktree> placeholders, and the baseline arm's tree was a transient /tmp git archive removed before the record was finalised.
justifications.evidence: Gate logs persist under the run's tests/ directory and reconcile: baseline 3+3+1 passed and after 3+3+1 passed across the three contract modules, so added_failure_count=0 with added_failure_ids=[] by test id; the gate-1 negative control records 77 base matches against 1 head match, a genuine positive control (I re-derived the 77). Gate 2 records 12/12 py_compile+import OK, exit 0. Held to 15 because (i) no test module imports or executes any of the twelve changed files, so the migration's runtime behaviour rests on static import alone — the twelve benchmarks were never run at either arm; (ii) the six gate logs carry no revision/tree/command header; (iii) the structured baseline_suite/after_suite are prose YAML bullets with placeholder-bearing commands rather than the documented JSON object.
justifications.fit: The change adopts the codebase's existing seam rather than inventing one: ForwardFluxOperator.with_clip_mode and the additive, keyword-only clip_mode: str | None = None pattern already exist from the certificate-hub and shared-helper migrations, and this commit consumes them unchanged. Every migrated call was checked against the head signature it invokes.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The goal — move the twelve leaf drivers off the process-global support clip mode — is delivered as written, and the threading is real rather than cosmetic: with_clip_mode returns a copy, _active_support_clip_mode prefers the explicit field, and receipts now report the solving operator's mode. Held one point because gate (1) reads one hit, not zero, at head: strictly the done-when's 'grep finds no ... in these files' is unmet, even though the hit is a test-module path literal rather than a symbol reference and the worker surfaced it correctly instead of editing a curated roster entry to make the grep green.
justifications.scope_discipline: The commit changes exactly the twelve declared benchmark paths and the declared evidence fragment, nothing more. No unrelated file, index, sprint state, or plan was touched; the working tree at the reviewed head is clean.
